question: Who among the following singers has been awarded with Bharat Ratna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar **

 
 
• Lata Mangeshkar was awarded the** Bharat Ratna in 2001**, India's highest civilian award, for her contributions to Indian music.
 
• She is one of the best-known and most respected playback singers in India and has recorded songs in over a thousand Hindi films.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar's career spanned over seven decades, during which** she sang in more than thirty-six Indian languages and foreign languages**.
 
• Her voice has been described as the **"Nightingale of India,"** and her songs have touched millions of hearts both in India and abroad.
